text.tspan: Plan
Review
commandOnEachRouteValidationPlan
For NEED-EE-001, a planned stakeholder
review. While the route through a zone
controller and the direct link run (SC-
EE-001 and SC-EE-002), can systems
engineers and verification engineers
confirm whether the command that the
actuation ECU applies on each route is the
command that the central computer gave?
Can system architects and systems
engineers tell, on each route, which
elements of the vehicle network exchange
the command on its way from the network
side of the central computer to the
actuation ECU, through the Ethernet
backbone and a zone controller or over the
direct link, and by which boundary
interface it enters the network from the
Eclipse S-CORE path? And can system
architects and product-line engineers tell
which elements make up the one topology
that holds both routes, in which role each
is used and what its relation to the
platform stack and to the vehicle network
boundary of the AAOS SDV middleware is
(gapEEStackAndNetworkBoundary), and judge
from that whether the product line admits
this topology as its reference vehicle
network?
networkFaultValidationPlan
For NEED-EE-002, a planned stakeholder
review. While a command fault on the route
and a link that goes down run (SC-EE-003
and SC-EE-004), can verification engineers
and safety experts confirm whether the
actuation ECU applied any command that was
lost, delayed, repeated or corrupted on
its way, or kept applying a command after
a link of its route went down, and whether
a response followed when no valid command
reached it, and which? Can safety experts
and systems engineers follow, for each
fault of the vehicle network on the route
of the command, the sequence from the
fault to its detection at the actuation
and to the response that follows there,
independent of the elements that realize
it? And can systems engineers and safety
experts tell which exchange item carries
the command on each part of its way, on
the Ethernet backbone, through a zone
controller and on CAN, and whether each
keeps the parts of the command by which
the actuation detects its loss, delay,
repetition or corruption, including where
a zone controller repacks it from Ethernet
to CAN?
runIdentityValidationPlan
For NEED-EE-003, a planned stakeholder
review. While the route through a zone
controller, the direct link, a command
fault on the route and a link that goes
down run (SC-EE-001 to SC-EE-004), can
verification engineers and product-line
engineers tell from each run which route
carried the command and which topology and
revision of the vehicle network ran, and
whether each verdict is bound to them?
